name: Disneyland Red Rose Taverne Cheeseburger, Chicken Tenders or Cheese Flatbread Pizza
whyItWorks: Offers straightforward Angus cheeseburgers on soft brioche buns, crispy chicken tenders, and kids' grilled chicken plates right in Fantasyland.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order a plain Cheeseburger (no secret sauce/pickles) or Kids' Chicken meal with fries or banana; if sharing "The Grey Stuff" cookies-and-cream mousse dessert, take a lactase enzyme.
watchOuts: Skip the spicy/tangy sauces on the specialty burgers and take lactase for cheese flatbreads or Grey Stuff mousse
